author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Big Improvements for PS2 Emulation on Android and more
summary: A news segment that explains ARMSX2’s unified Mali improvements and Play!’s compatibility progress before the video moves to unrelated technology stories.

blocks.text: Mr. Sujano devotes the opening section to Android PS2 emulation. The ARMSX2 portion summarizes integrated Mali fixes, OpenGL behavior, GPU profile overrides, disc swapping, frame-rate controls, sub-native resolution scales, memory-card sizes and other usability work. It then briefly covers new playable software and multi-platform progress in the Play! emulator.

This is not a full setup or benchmark: the PS2 material occupies roughly the first three minutes of a broader news roundup, after which the video moves to BizHawk and unrelated technology topics. Its value is a sourced overview of two active Android approaches and the specific mechanisms being changed. Performance claims still need confirmation on the viewer’s GPU and games.
